dossiers.thesis_summary: Vir Biotechnology's resolving event is the ECLIPSE 1 Phase 3 topline readout in chronic hepatitis delta (tobevibart + elebsiran), a pure idiosyncratic clinical binary dated Q4 2026 — confirmed by both the Jan 12 2026 corporate update and the May 6 2026 Q1 earnings release; ECLIPSE 2/3 follow in Q1 2027. Unfired, forward-dated, resolves on its own trial facts not the tape. Binary_prob axes: win re-rate ~$19, net-cash miss floor ~$4.8, win_prob ~0.55.

dossiers.kill_risk: The Q4-2026 ECLIPSE 1 readout is a pure clinical binary with NO contractual payout — no CVR, no deal-break price, no financing backstop — so the ~$4.8 downside is a SOFT net-cash level (discretionary market re-rate), not a hard floor; a Phase 3 miss can overshoot below net cash for a cash-burning biotech. Secondary risk: HDV commercial TAM is contested by Gilead's already-approved bulevirtide (ECLIPSE 1 is scoped to the US/regions where bulevirtide use is limited), and win_prob is a P2-informed estimate, not a contractually derived number.

dossiers.dossier_note: CATALYST REAL, UNFIRED, DATED. ECLIPSE 1 topline Q4 2026 verified against latest company comms (May 6 2026 Q1 earnings + Jan 12 2026 corporate update both state Q4 2026); the prior skeptic's Q1-2027 demotion was off a stale Nov-2025 release and is correctly reversed. Distinct from the Astellas VIR-5500 (PSMA oncology) deal that closed Apr 2026 — that re-rating is a separate program and did NOT spend the HDV edge. VALUATION (binary_prob, own arithmetic): pro-forma cash = $809.3M (Mar 31 2026) + $315M Astellas upfront/equity (Q2 2026) = ~$1,124M; 168.65M shares; runway into H2 2028 => ~$140M/qtr burn. By the Q4 readout, cash ~ $1,124M - ~$350M (2.5 qtrs) = ~$770M => $4.6/sh gross; apply small post-miss discount => downside_floor ~$4.8 (SOFT — no CVR/backstop). Win case: fair_value_target ~$19 (HDV P3 success re-rate toward, but below, the $21.56 Strong-Buy mean PT). win_prob 0.55 (P2 SOLSTICE virologic data supportive; deferred-treatment comparator). EV = 0.55*19 + 0.45*4.8 = $12.6 vs $9.25 live. NOT a commodity/deck name — deck-mark gate N/A. Note: one live feed mislabeled ECLIPSE 1 as a prostate-cancer comparison; that is a feed error — ECLIPSE 1 is the hepatitis delta tobevibart+elebsiran Phase 3.
